scope: Guest agent hotfix: only usr/local/sbin/yougori-agent changed in the appliance base, its verified initramfs and the CUDA payload; no user disk, package or other executable changed
reason: Agents from 1.0.16 bind the data tree under its Yougori name; storage prepared by earlier releases kept it under the earlier name, so attaching it failed. The fixed agent moves it first.

agent.build: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 go build -buildvcs=false -trimpath -ldflags='-s -w -buildid=' (go1.27.2), as in scripts/build-appliance.sh and build-cuda.sh
agent.reproducibility: The previous source rebuilt with the same command reproduced the old agent byte for byte
